definitions.explanation: A long-legged wading bird with a long neck and pointed beak, commonly found near water.

examples.english: A heron was catching fish in the river.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白鷺|しらさぎ}→白鷺：28731_shirasagi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A white egret is standing in the rice paddy.

examples.japanese: {鷺|さぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{脚|あし}→脚：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{水辺|みずべ}→水辺：19882_mizube⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}きます→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: Herons walk along the waterside on their long legs.

notes:
{鷺|さぎ} is a general term for herons and egrets.

Common types in Japan:
- ⟦{白鷺|しらさぎ}→白鷺：28731_shirasagi⟧ (white egret) - includes great egret, little egret
- ⟦{青鷺|あおさぎ}→青鷺：28732_aosagi⟧ (grey heron)
- ⟦{五位鷺|ごいさぎ}→五位鷺：noentry⟧ (night heron)

{白鷺城|しらさぎじょう} is another name for {姫路城|ひめじじょう} (Himeji Castle), due to its white walls resembling a white heron in flight.

Note: Not to be confused with ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧ (fraud), which has the same reading.
